item.title: Naira gains 7.4% in 2025, first annual rise in 13 years
item.description: Nigeria’s naira closed 2025 on a stronger note, recording its first full-year appreciation in more than a decade, as foreign exchange reforms and improved market transparency helped stabilise the currency after years of persistent decline. item.title: Selective buying lifts banking stocks despite lagging market in 2025
item.description: Nigeria’s banking equities recorded a mixed but broadly positive performance in 2025, with the NGX Banking Index rising by 39.77 per cent, according to year-end data from the Nigerian Exchange (NGX).
